rationale.quality-debt: Copilot adoption increased rework, indicating technical debt and maintainability decline.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Core maintainers reviewed more while producing substantially less original code.
rationale.hitl-workflow: PR checkpoints let maintainers request changes, reject, or approve contributions.
rationale.metrics: Defines and applies PR rework as a quality debt measure.
rationale.counterpoint: Challenges productivity-first claims by demonstrating hidden maintenance costs.
rationale.problem-statement-anchor: Headline review increase and productivity decline anchor the oversight burden.
rationale.assistive: Studies human-initiated GitHub Copilot code suggestions.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically measures increased rework and analyzes long-term maintainability harms.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes reliance without understanding among less-experienced contributors.
rationale.method-mining: Uses GitHub repository, pull-request, commit, and review activity data.
